title: Aletheia: Quantifying Cognitive Conviction in Reasoning Models via Regularized Inverse Confusion Matrix

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling the LLM judge as a noisy measurement channel, constructing its confusion matrix on a calibrated Golden Set of adversarial dialogues, and applying Tikhonov Regularization to mathematically invert the matrix and filter out the model's bias towards compliant, sycophantic responses.
